_comment: 台帳。海外で定着しているのに日本でほとんど紹介されていないツール。docs/research/2026-09-12-tool-gap-candidates.md の 30 本。手で編集してよい唯一の data ファイル（data/bsky と違い、投稿ログではなく選定の正典）。what は日本語ダイジェストの材料、evidence は投稿 1 行目の【】に入る短い印。URL は 2026-09-14 に全件 200 を確認。

tools.name: Tana
tools.what: AI knowledge graph outliner. Notes become structured objects with supertags; $25M raised, 160k waitlist.

tools.name: Heptabase
tools.what: Whiteboard-style personal knowledge management: cards on infinite canvases for learning and research. Product Hunt Golden Kitty 2024, profitable.

tools.name: Granola
tools.what: AI meeting notes without a bot joining the call; transcribes from your device and merges with your own notes. $125M raised.

tools.name: Motion
tools.what: AI project manager and calendar that automatically reschedules tasks around meetings. 100k customers, $60M raised.

tools.name: Reclaim.ai
tools.what: Calendar automation that blocks time for habits, tasks and breaks; acquired by Dropbox. 600k users.

tools.name: Cal.com
tools.what: Open-source scheduling pages (Calendly alternative) with self-hosting. GitHub 44.6k stars, $32.4M raised.

tools.name: Fillout
tools.what: Form builder that writes answers into Notion, Airtable, Google Sheets and more; hundreds of G2 and Capterra reviews at 4.7 to 4.8.

tools.name: Snipd
tools.what: Podcast player that turns highlights into notes and sends them to Notion or Readwise.

tools.name: Readwise Reader
tools.what: Read-it-later app for articles, PDFs, newsletters and YouTube with highlights and spaced repetition; where many went after Pocket shut down.

tools.name: Consensus
tools.what: AI search that answers questions by citing peer-reviewed papers. 400k monthly users, $41.5M raised.

tools.name: Attio
tools.what: AI-native CRM with flexible data model; customers include OpenAI and Vercel. $124M raised.

tools.name: folk
tools.what: Lightweight CRM for small teams with LinkedIn and Gmail integration; 300+ G2 reviews at 4.5.

tools.name: Customer.io
tools.what: Behavior-triggered email, push and SMS messaging platform. $100M ARR, 4,600 companies.

tools.name: Lemon Squeezy
tools.what: Payments and merchant of record for indie developers: handles global sales tax and VAT. Acquired by Stripe.

tools.name: Kit
tools.what: Email marketing for creators (formerly ConvertKit): newsletters, automations, paid subscriptions. 63k customers, free up to 10k subscribers.

tools.name: Ghost
tools.what: Open-source publishing platform with built-in newsletters and paid memberships; used by about 8,600 domains.

tools.name: Feather
tools.what: Write in Notion, publish an SEO-friendly blog on your own domain. Product Hunt #1 with 935 votes.

tools.name: Skool
tools.what: Community plus courses platform with a single flat price; over 10,000 paid communities, $26M to $50M ARR.
tools.evidence: 有料コミュニティ 1 万超

tools.name: Circle
tools.what: Branded community platform with courses, events and paid memberships; 401 G2 reviews at 4.6.

tools.name: Chatwoot
tools.what: Open-source customer support inbox (Intercom alternative) for chat, email and social channels; self-host or cloud. Y Combinator alumni.

tools.name: Arcade
tools.what: Record clicks in your product and turn them into interactive demos to embed anywhere. $14M from Kleiner Perkins, G2 4.7.

tools.name: Supademo
tools.what: AI-assisted interactive product demos and guides; 60k to 100k users, 523 G2 reviews.

tools.name: Storylane
tools.what: Story-style interactive product demos for sales and marketing; #1 in its G2 category with 1,500+ reviews.

tools.name: Pitch
tools.what: Presentation software with real-time collaboration and viewer analytics. $137M raised, G2 4.4.

tools.name: Rive
tools.what: Interactive animations that run in apps and games at runtime; used by Spotify, LinkedIn and Duolingo.

tools.name: Spline
tools.what: 3D design tool in the browser for web and product visuals; 7 million scenes created, $41M raised.

tools.name: Jitter
tools.what: Motion design in the browser for UI animations and social videos; Product Hunt #2.

tools.name: Penpot
tools.what: Open-source design and prototyping tool (Figma alternative) that can be self-hosted. GitHub 59.9k stars.

tools.name: Cap
tools.what: Open-source screen recorder with instant shareable links (Loom alternative). GitHub 18k stars.

tools.name: Screen Studio
tools.what: Mac screen recorder that automatically adds zooms and smooth cursor motion for polished demo videos. Product Hunt Product of the Year.
